title: E-DI pass — one run of one channel against one artifact, filed beside the record that names it. A pass of the checker is not C8.

kind.description: scored — the pass produced a per-dimension score. confirmation — the pass read a rule through a second channel to cross-check a reading another channel produced. How a confirmation reading weighs is the instrument's declaration, not this schema's.

void_cause.description: Required when status is void: why the pass produced no usable reading. A pass that was attempted and produced nothing is filed as void, never omitted.

run_ref.description: The host's own identifier for the run, recorded as the host's value. This corpus does not interpret it, and no corpus rule may require a host-specific name.

allOf.comment: A void pass names its cause and carries no scores. A filed pass carries scores: a pass that observed nothing is void, not filed-and-empty.

comment: Whether a channel is a model channel is NOT machine-decidable here: this corpus defines no channel vocabulary, and it does not invent one (the P0/P1/P2 precedent). `provider`, `model` and `family` are therefore validated when present and their absence where the channel is a model is an audit item under C34, not a structural error. Family is what §4 role independence turns on.
